signals.derivation: Replatform verdict: container-native TypeScript NestJS stack (INV-01); Prisma ORM portable; Redis queue externalised. Primary constraints: EGR-01 Yahoo Finance US-only (migration blocker), EGR-02 AlphaVantage US-only (migration blocker). Confidence medium: two EGR blockers require resolution before OTC cutover.

Refactor rejected: no fundamental architectural anti-patterns; NestJS maps cleanly to sovereign target. Re-architect rejected: stack is cloud-portable without structural rework. Retain rejected: BaFin DORA compliance gap on current Hetzner tenancy forces migration.

Migration gate: EGR-01 Yahoo Finance and EGR-02 AlphaVantage have no sovereign-cloud equivalents. Path options: (A) self-hosted market data feed; (B) sovereign-certified data provider contract. Gate must resolve before OTC cutover. Contract expiry 2026-09-30 sets hard deadline.

assessment.migration_rationale: NestJS TypeScript stack is cloud-portable with no architectural anti-patterns. Two US-only market data providers (EGR-01, EGR-02) are migration gates requiring resolution before OTC cutover. Post-migration: JWT upgrade to RS256 (CRYPTO-03), Factor XI build reproducibility (TF-05).
recommended_next_steps: Resolve EGR-01: identify sovereign-certified market data feed or self-hosted alternative
Resolve EGR-02: evaluate AlphaVantage EU contract or open-source alternative
Upgrade JWT signing from symmetric HMAC to RS256 with KMS-backed key (CRYPTO-03)
Establish OTC STACKIT tenant and run connectivity tests with sovereign landing zone
